title: Test
note:
This flower represents beauty, growth, and the quiet strength found in nature. I wanted to capture the delicate balance between softness and resilience—the way a flower can appear fragile while continuing to grow toward the light.Sun: Full sun to light shade (afternoon shade in hot climates helps)
Soil: Well-draining, slightly acidic to neutral, rich in organic matter
Planting: Bulbs in fall (or early spring in cold areas); plant 3× the bulb’s height deep
